summary.root_cause_text: payment_provider_url was hot-reloaded from internal://payments-v1 to internal://payments-v2, which is unreachable; the worker marked orders processed without payment (failures logged only at DEBUG).
recommended: Find who changed the provider URL to payments-v2, and confirm the v2 endpoint before any migration.
Log payment provider failures at ERROR and alert on them.
Validate config changes before they hot-reload.
Make the worker requeue an order, not mark it processed, when payment fails.
